MainHeader.summary: The main header component provides site-wide navigation with the brand logo on the left and navigation links on the right. It includes a responsive hamburger menu for mobile devices and highlights the active page.

MainFooter.summary: The footer component displays the brand name, a condensed set of navigation links, contact information, social media icons, and a copyright notice. It uses a dark background with light text for contrast.

HomeContent.summary: The homepage hero section introduces the brand with a bold headline, supporting subtitle, and a primary call-to-action button. It uses a full-width layout with a background gradient and centered text content.

AboutContent.summary: The about page shares the brand's mission, story, and values. It includes a brief team introduction section and a call-to-action inviting visitors to get in touch.

ServicesContent.summary: The services page presents the brand's core offerings in a visually organized card grid layout. Each service card includes an icon, title, and brief description. A closing CTA encourages visitors to start a project.

ContactContent.summary: The contact page provides a simple contact form with name, email, subject, and message fields. It also displays the brand's email address, phone number, and physical location.

FeaturesContent.summary: The features page showcases the key benefits and differentiators of the brand's offering. Each feature is presented in a card with an icon, title, and description, arranged in a responsive grid.

TestimonialsContent.summary: The testimonials page displays client feedback in a clean card layout. Each testimonial includes a quote, client name, title, and a star rating. The page builds trust through social proof.
